ir.description: Select-and-place MILP for a single container. Incremental fix: added orient_valid_{i}_{m} to forbid orientation binaries for (item,orientation) pairs absent from orientations.csv, so items cannot be loaded using a spurious zero-size orientation (which previously inflated the objective above the reference).
assumptions: item_id values are integers 0..N-1 and sorted, so index arithmetic i+k enumerates unordered pairs (i,i+k).
There is a single container row with container_id 0; refs use key_value 0.

orientation_id values come from orientations.csv; the orientation binary family is the cross product of all item_ids and all orientation_ids, so pairs (i,m) not present in orientations.csv are made inactive by orient_valid_{i}_{m} (rhs resolves to 0 when the key is missing).
Big-M in each axis is set to the corresponding container dimension; this is sufficient because inside_* constraints enforce pos + oriented_extent <= container_dim and positions are nonnegative.

Binary separation variables are only required to hold when both items are selected; the sep_at_least constraints include -y_i -y_j >= -1, and invalid index pairs are skipped by out-of-range index arithmetic.
